post.description: Ask the assistant about your own portfolio, goals and net worth. The answer streams as server-sent events of these types: token, tool, source, done, error. `tool` shows which tool ran (name and status only), `source` names the data the answer rests on with its as-of time, `token` carries the answer text (the answer is checked before any of it is sent), `done` closes the turn and `error` ends it with a fixed code. Figures come from WealthSphere's tools, never from the model. Limits: 30 questions per user per 24 hours, 20 tool calls per question.

post.description:
Adds the amount (in the portfolio's base currency) to the portfolio as new money and
re-measures it with the Portfolio Doctor's rules: concentration, asset class, currency and
liquidity before and after, and the checks that would change. The verdict is not_suitable
when the instrument is not eligible for you or the amount is below its minimum, caution when
something gets materially worse, and fits otherwise. Hypothetical, never an order; another
user's portfolio is not found.

get.description:
Every active instrument's score from 0 to 100, decomposed into factor contributions
(stability, resilience, past momentum, cost, liquidity, risk class) with the configured
weights. Factors that could not be measured are listed and lower the coverage and confidence;
with too little data there is no score. Scores describe measured characteristics: they are
not forecasts, expected returns or recommendations.
